Below is the diff with specific changes to fix the linter errors. In summary, I did the following:

1. Imported the missing TypeScript types (including FeatureCollection).
2. Changed the argument passed to useTimeSeriesAnimation from an empty object ({}) to an empty array ([]).
3. Updated mapConfig so that pitch is a tuple (i.e. [45]) instead of a plain number.
4. Added a helper function toCoordinate to safely transform coordinates (ensuring they are a two-number tuple), then used it in both the sightings and military bases layers.

Below is the diff (only modified lines are shown):

```diff
--- src/features/data-viz/sightings/sightings-globe-refactored.tsx (before)
+++ src/features/data-viz/sightings/sightings-globe-refactored.tsx (after)
@@ near top (imports)
 import 'mapbox-gl/dist/mapbox-gl.css'
+import type { FeatureCollection } from 'geojson'
@@ immediately after imports, add helper:
+function toCoordinate(coords: unknown): [number, number] {
+  return Array.isArray(coords) && coords.length >= 2 ? [coords[0], coords[1]] : [0, 0];
+}
@@ in component where useTimeSeriesAnimation is used:
-  const {year, month, isAnimating, startAnimation, stopAnimation, timeRange, setTimeRange} =
-     useTimeSeriesAnimation({})
+  const {year, month, isAnimating, startAnimation, stopAnimation, timeRange, setTimeRange} =
+     useTimeSeriesAnimation([]);
@@ in mapConfig declaration:
-   const [mapConfig, setMapConfig] = useState<MapConfig>({
-     zoom: [3],
-     center: [0, 0],
-     pitch: 45,
-   })
+   const [mapConfig, setMapConfig] = useState<MapConfig>({
+     zoom: [3],
+     center: [0, 0],
+     pitch: [45],
+   })
@@ in sightings layer mapping, update coordinates:
-                  <Feature
-                    key={`sighting-${feature.properties.id || index}`}
-                    coordinates={feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number]}
-                    onClick={() =>
-                      setPopupInfo({
-                        coordinates: feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number],
-                        properties: feature.properties,
-                      })
-                    }
-                  />
+                  <Feature
+                    key={`sighting-${feature.properties.id || index}`}
+                    coordinates={toCoordinate(feature.geometry.coordinates)}
+                    onClick={() =>
+                      setPopupInfo({
+                        coordinates: toCoordinate(feature.geometry.coordinates),
+                        properties: feature.properties,
+                      })
+                    }
+                  />
@@ in military bases layer mapping:
-              {militaryBases.features.map((feature: GeoJSONFeature, index: number) => (
-                <Feature
-                  key={`base-${feature.properties.id || index}`}
-                  coordinates={feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number]}
-                  onClick={() =>
-                    setPopupInfo({
-                      coordinates: feature.geometry.coordinates as [number, number],
-                      properties: feature.properties,
-                    })
-                  }
-                />
-              ))}
+              {militaryBases.features.map((feature: GeoJSONFeature, index: number) => (
+                <Feature
+                  key={`base-${feature.properties.id || index}`}
+                  coordinates={toCoordinate(feature.geometry.coordinates)}
+                  onClick={() =>
+                    setPopupInfo({
+                      coordinates: toCoordinate(feature.geometry.coordinates),
+                      properties: feature.properties,
+                    })
+                  }
+                />
+              ))}
@@ in filteredSightings computation:
-  const filteredSightings = useMemo(() => {
-    return {
-      type: sightings?.type || 'FeatureCollection',
-      features: filteredFeatures,
-    }
-  }, [sightings, filteredFeatures])
+  const filteredSightings = useMemo(() => {
+    return {
+      type: 'FeatureCollection',
+      features: filteredFeatures,
+    } as FeatureCollection
+  }, [sightings, filteredFeatures])
```

These changes should resolve the errors:
- The hook call now uses an empty array.
- Map configuration now passes pitch as a tuple.
- The filtered sightings object is explicitly typed.
- Both Feature components transform coordinates via the helper.

Sources: TypeScript docs, GeoJSON type definitions.
